name: octopost
description: Publish, schedule and queue social media posts on X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn from a chat. Write a post or a thread once, send it to the accounts you connected, hold it for a person's approval, and check how it did.

interface.longDescription:
Octopost publishes to the social accounts you connect at octopost.ink. Write a post once and send it to X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn (personal profiles), now, at a time you pick, or into a queue that spaces posts out during your active hours.

Things you can ask:
- Post "We just shipped dark mode" to X and Bluesky.
- Turn this paragraph into an X thread and check that every part fits.
- Schedule this for LinkedIn next Monday at 9am New York time.
- Add these five posts to my queue and hold them until I approve.
- Which of my posts failed this week, and why? Retry the ones that can be retried.
- How did yesterday's post do?

Octopost checks each network's limits before anything is sent, handles images and video, and keeps a record of every post with a link to it on each network. You can require a person to approve posts before they go out: held posts wait until someone approves them by email or in the dashboard.

Networks: X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn personal profiles work today. Threads opens once Meta approves Octopost's app. Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest and Reddit are not available yet.

You need an Octopost account with at least one connected social account. Connect accounts at octopost.ink; your social network passwords never pass through this app.
capabilities: Publish a post or thread to X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn
Schedule a post for an exact time in any time zone
Queue posts that go out at spaced intervals
Hold posts until a person approves them
Check a post against each network's limits before sending
Edit, reschedule, retry or delete posts
See likes, reposts and replies on published posts
List connected accounts and recent posts

positive.prompt: Which social accounts do I have connected in Octopost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's three connected accounts: Review sandbox (X), Review sandbox (Bluesky) and Review sandbox (LinkedIn). Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Publish a post to two networks
positive.prompt: Post "We just shipped dark mode." to X and Bluesky.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the post for X and Bluesky. The review account requires a person to approve every post, so the result says it is held for approval (status pending_approval) and nothing is published. It can be deleted with delete_post.

positive.prompt: Schedule a LinkedIn post for next Monday at 9am New York time: "Our November update is out."
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the post for LinkedIn at next Monday 9:00 America/New_York and reports its id and time. On the review account it is held for approval, so it will not publish even when the time comes.

positive.description: Split long text into a thread
positive.prompt: Turn this into an X thread and check every part fits: Octopost lets you write a post once and send it to X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn. It checks each network's limits first, handles images and video, and keeps a record of every post with a link to it on each network. You can also hold posts until a person approves them, schedule them for an exact time, or drop them in a queue that spaces them out.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the text split into thread parts that each fit X's 280 character limit and reports that every part fits. Nothing is saved or published.

positive.description: List recent posts and their status
positive.prompt: Show me my recent Octopost posts and their status.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the review account's posts, newest first, with each post's status (for example pending approval, scheduled or draft), networks and time. Nothing is changed.

negative.description: General knowledge has nothing to do with the user's posts. Octopost should not be called.
Asking for writing help without asking to post or save it needs no Octopost call. The model should just write the text.
negative.prompt: Give me three ideas for a fun tweet about coffee.

negative.description: Octopost only works with the user's own connected accounts. It can't look up someone else's followers, so it should not be called.
negative.prompt: How many followers does NASA have on X?

review.commerce_description: Octopost does not sell, offer or display anything for purchase inside this app. It only creates and reads the signed-in user's own posts, schedules and connected accounts. No prices or payment links appear in tool responses or in the sign-in flow when used from here.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, schedule and queue posts on X, Bluesky, Mastodon and LinkedIn, hold them for approval, and check results.
